clips.title: The story
paras: Sputtervalve carries an order from Undermine to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, the gnome engineer hired by Mogul Razdunk, must be eliminated.

The Venture Company’s hiring of Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle has stirred trouble among Undermine’s rulers. Mogul Razdunk brought the gnome engineer into the company, and word of it reached the Trade Princes. Director Riddlevox told Sputtervalve to intervene quietly. Sputtervalve believes the order comes from the highest trade authorities, so he passes the work to Ziz Fizziks, the operative nearest the scene.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.
Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.

Gnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate Dun Morogh well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
